svg.title: Booking screen: reserve shared button styling for actual actions
svg.desc: Only the noninteractive availability background opacity changes from 1 to 0 and its text fill from cream to dark green. The two action surfaces and labels are unchanged. All wording, type styles/sizes, positions, spacing, photograph/crop, phone and lighting stay fixed. Availability remains static information in both versions; Book a place and Ask about access are intended actions. Original fictional static mockup, not a working interface.
